sentences: Dominoes is a game played with small tiles called dominoes.
A domino is a rectangular tile with a line in the middle that separates it into two sides.
Each side has a number of black spots.
The number of spots is different on each domino.
Some dominoes have a side that is blank.
The games possible with these objects resemble card games.
Friday, December 6, 2024 On Monday, December 2, Israel launched its largest wave of airstrikes across Lebanon since a ceasefire came into effect.
Eleven civilians were killed in the airstrikes.
The strikes were launched by Israel in response to the firing of projectiles against Israeli forces by Hezbollah.
The firing was the first Hezbollah attack on Israeli forces since the ceasefire agreement.
Hezbollah claimed Israel themselves had violated the ceasefire agreement, and that their attacks were a warning shot because of this.
Israel claims that Hezbollah had violated the ceasefire on several unspecified occasions.
As of December 6, both sides have repeatedly accused the other of violating the ceasefire, and strikes by Israel have continued.
The ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah has reportedly been violated on several occasions since November 28, two days after it came into effect.
The ceasefire deal was first proposed by Amos Hochstein, a top official in the Joe Biden administration of the United States.
On Sunday, November 25, it was announced that the proposal was pending an Israeli response.
European Union foreign policy chief Josep Borrell said the proposal was waiting final approval by Israel.
"We must pressure the Israeli government and maintain the pressure on Hezbollah to accept the US proposal for a ceasefire," he said in Beirut after meeting Lebanese officials.
One day later, Israel and Hezbollah negotiated the ceasefire and it came into effect.

However, on Thursday, November 28, Israel fired airstrikes in Lebanon, claiming that they were done in response to Hezbollah's activity in a rocket storage facility in southern Lebanon which allegedly breached the ceasefire.
On the same day, the Lebanese Army alleged that Israel had violated the ceasefire by striking Lebanon with "various weapons" and continuing to surveil Lebanese skies with warplanes and drones.
Israeli forces have said troops will be withdrawn gradually as they ensure that the ceasefire is being enforced.
A virtuoso is someone (usually in the performing arts) who is an expert in his or her field.
A musical virtuoso is one who plays a musical instrument very well.
Musicians who have exceptional talent and can play extremely fast and difficult music are "virtuosi" (plural of "virtuoso").
In the 19th century Niccolò Paganini was a virtuoso violinist as well as a composer.
Franz Liszt was a virtuoso pianist and composer.
Musicians may sometimes talk about “virtuoso music” meaning music which is so difficult that only a virtuoso could play it.

title_en: India defeats New Zealand to win 2025 Champions Trophy
sentences: Monday, March 10, 2025 On March 9, at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium, India defeated New Zealand by four wickets to win the 2025 Champions Trophy.
This was the ninth edition of the tournament and marked India's third title win.
The competition was hosted by the Pakistan Cricket Board, starting on February 19.
After winning the toss, New Zealand chose to bat first and scored 251 runs for the loss of 7 wickets.
They made a steady start, reaching 69 runs for one wicket, with Rachin Ravindra contributing 29 runs.
Daryl Mitchell was the top scorer with 63 off 101 balls, while Glenn Phillips added 34 runs.
In the final phase, Michael Bracewell's unbeaten 53 off 40 balls helped New Zealand set a target of 252.
India's spinners performed well, with Kuldeep Yadav taking 2 wickets for 40 runs and Varun Chakravarthy 2 for 45.
India's chase started with captain Rohit Sharma scoring a quick half-century, including several boundaries and three sixes.
However, a sudden collapse saw India lose three wickets for just 17 runs, including Shubman Gill's 31 and Virat Kohli's 1.
Shreyas Iyer's 48 and Axar Patel's 29 helped stabilize the innings.
KL Rahul's unbeaten knock guided India to the target of 252 with seven balls to spare, securing a 4-wicket victory.
For New Zealand, Michael Bracewell and Mitchell Santner took 2 wickets each, with figures of 2-28 and 2-46 respectively.
Rachin Ravindra from New Zealand's team won the Player of the Tournament award, while Rohit Sharma was named Player of the Match.
Matt Henry ended as the leading wicket taker of the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 with 10 wickets, despite being ruled out of the final due to a shoulder injury.
After the match, India's captain expressed his gratitude to the supporters, saying, "I appreciate everyone who came to support us.
An artisan is a skilled worker who makes things with his or her hands.
The things artisans make can be either for use or for decoration.
Some of the things they make are furniture, sculpture, clothing, jewellery, household items, and tools.
Sometimes artisans make things by hand that are usually made by machine today.
The hand-made items can be called "artisanal".
Some of those items are food products, including bread, beverages or cheese.

title_en: Man arrested after driving wrong way on Interstate 93 in New Hampshire
sentences: Thursday, April 24, 2025 A man from Lowell, Massachusetts was arrested Monday after driving the wrong way on Interstate 93 in New Hampshire near Exit 34C in Franconia Notch at 11 p.m. Sunday night said state police.
According to state police, near Exit 39, the man was driving straight toward them in the fast lane.
Early efforts to pull him over did not succeed.
Troopers soon spotted another vehicle heading southbound, directly in the path of the driver going the wrong way.
Fortunately, the southbound driver managed to steer clear of the oncoming vehicle.
A short time later, the man was pulled over onto the shoulder of the road, where officers took him into custody.
The man faces charges including reckless conduct, driving after his license was revoked or suspended, a third DWI offense, and disobeying a police officer, according to state police.
The man is being held in preventive detention and is scheduled for arraignment in Littleton District Court at a later date.
A pet is a domesticated animal that lives with people, but is not forced to work and is not eaten, in most instances.
In most cases, a pet is kept to entertain people or for companionship.
Some pets such as dogs and cats are placed in an animal shelter if there is no one willing to take care of them.
If no one adopts it or the pet is too old/sick, the pet may be euthanized or in some cases even abandoned.
Dogs, cats, fish, rodents, lagomorphs, ferrets, birds, certain reptiles and amphibians, and a wide variety of arthropods such as tarantulas and hermit crabs are the most common pets in North America.
Horses, elephants, oxen, and donkeys are usually made to work, so they are not usually called pets.
Some dogs also do work for people, and it was once common for some birds (like falcons and carrier pigeons) to work for humans.
Rodents are very popular pets.
The most common are guinea pigs, hamsters (especially Syrian and dwarf hamsters), mice and rats.
Rabbits are also very popular pets.
Bloomberg Intelligence estimated that the pet care market across the world was worth $320 billion in 2024 and growing rapidly.

title_en: Gunman enters Pennsylvania hospital ICU, kills officer before police fatally shoot him
sentences: Wednesday, February 26, 2025 UPMC Memorial Hospital shooting.png Shortly after 10:30 a.m. EST (1530 UTC) on Saturday, a gunman entered the intensive care unit (ICU) at UPMC Memorial Hospital in York, Pennsylvania, taking hospital staff hostage at gunpoint.
Officers arrived at the scene and confronted the gunman as he attempted to leave with a hostage, opening fire.

Before being shot dead, he fatally wounded backup officer Andrew Duarte, 30, of the West York Borough Police Department, and injured five others, including two police officers, a nurse, a doctor, and a custodian.
A hospital staff member was also hurt while attempting to flee.
Authorities reported the gunman was armed with a pistol and zip ties.
According to Lester Mendoza, a physician assistant at UPMC Memorial Hospital, the gunman had visited the ICU the previous week when a family member was dying.
One of the sources, Campus Safety Magazine, reported three police officers having been injured by the gunman.
Other sources, including Associated Press, Pioneer Press, and WTAE-TV, reported only two police officers having been injured by the gunman.
UPMC Memorial Hospital released a statement thanking law enforcement, saying, "This is a fluid situation.
Law enforcement is on premises and is managing the situation.
We are grateful to all the local law enforcement agencies for their quick response."
